notes.title: Alpha 0.1.8 Trial Demo Final
notes.content:
🔥 PostApo – Trial Demo 0.1.8 – Major Yearly Update! 🔥
📢 Survivors, welcome back to the Zone!
After a year of active development, we are bringing you the biggest update yet for Trial Demo 0.1.8!
This isn't just a minor patch – the game has undergone a complete overhaul.
The world is now more alive, more dangerous, and packed with new mechanics that will immerse you deeper into the post-apocalyptic experience.
If you’ve played PostApo before, now is the perfect time to return!
And if you’re jumping in for the first time, get ready for a thrilling 120-minute survival experience!

🆕 What's New in Trial Demo 0.1.8?
🌍 A World Full of Threats and Opportunities
✔ Completely revamped map – more details, better atmosphere, and deadlier threats!
✔ Contaminated Zone – an area where entering without a protective helmet means radiation will eat you alive in minutes.
✔ Dynamic weather affects gameplay – blizzards, toxic fog, and scorching heat can mean death if you’re not prepared.
✔ Randomized loot – no two playthroughs will be the same! Loot now spawns dynamically, encouraging exploration and adaptation.

⚒️ Advanced Crafting and Construction
✔ New crafting materials – nails are now available as an essential resource for building structures and upgrades.
✔ Defensive spike barricades – slow down and injure intruders who try to breach your defenses.
✔ Improved repair system – weapons and gear can now be repaired, making survival easier and reducing waste.

🛒 Expanded Economy and Trading
✔ Merchant inventory expanded – 21 new items available for purchase and 20 more for sale.
✔ New barter system – some rare items cannot be bought or sold with currency; they must be traded.
✔ Dynamic pricing based on world events – for example, if water becomes scarce, its price skyrockets.

⚔️ Combat Has Never Been More Intense
✔ New enemies and wildlife – we’ve added not only wild animals but also deadly predators that hunt YOU.
✔ UV light as a weapon against mutants – but beware, it drains power quickly, so use it wisely.
✔ Combat system improvements – weapons now have different effectiveness based on enemy types.
✔ Reworked gravitational anomalies – if they pull you in, it's over – no escape!

🔥 Survival Is Tougher (and More Fun) Than Ever
✔ New farming system – harvest dried corn to obtain plant fibers for crafting clothes and other essentials.
✔ Campfires and cooking – new recipes added, and more are coming!
✔ Hunger and thirst mechanics improved – food no longer instantly restores hunger but gradually replenishes it over time, forcing better survival planning.

🛠️ Bug Fixes and Optimizations
✔ Better FPS and smoother gameplay – we’ve optimized the game for better performance, even on lower-end PCs.
✔ Improved inventory management – better organization, stackable items, and realistic grid sizes.
✔ More natural animal behavior – some fear you, others will hunt you mercilessly.
✔ Fixed many known issues and glitches – thanks to your feedback, we’ve eliminated several bugs and rough edges.

💡 What Happens After Your 120-Minute Trial?
If you enjoy the game (and we believe you will! 😉), you’ll have the option to continue in the full version and unlock:
🔓 The complete storyline – full quests, merchant interactions, and lore.
🔓 More game mechanics – multiplayer, expanded factions, and deeper combat.
🔓 Base building and advanced crafting systems.
🔓 Exclusive areas and new maps not available in the demo.

🙏 Thank You for Your Support and Feedback!
The Trial Demo is free, but your support and feedback are invaluable to us! You help us improve the game and push it further.
🔹 Enjoyed the demo? Add the game to your library and continue surviving!
🔹 Share your experience – your feedback helps shape future updates!
🔹 Stay tuned for more PostApo updates – new content is coming regularly!

Thanks for playing and good luck in the Zone!
💀 The PostApo Team 💀

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.0.2+
notes.content:
Hello to everybody,

So I made a lot of fixes and improvements.

Added:
More trees, resources and a few buildings. I still kept the burned area.
Zones: Prohibition of buildings for buildings from the history of mankind. For those who want peace, I have prepared a few islands for them to inhabit. It has the raw materials for development there.

Safe Zone:
In the center of the map is a huge hangar. There will be a shopping center. You are safe there.
I still have plans for this place and it's not finished. At least I threw a merchant into that void.
But his business offer is poor now. I'm working on a sales list. Make suggestions as to what the currency will be.
Buy sell ratios etc. Thanks.
Multiple zones where enemies or monsters spawn. (Mutants.)

HUD
Added current weather information. You know exactly what the weather is like and the temperature too.
It affects sea level and floods or droughts.

You can start local servers directly in the game - It is not a dedicated server - Reserved.

I turned on Nanite and the sky is no longer 2D. AMD FSR 3.0 support incl. AI image generation.

Fixed:
The sea already fully supports multiplayer. The client knows the correct water level. He knows her height.
The server remembers and stores the level height. Always load the last one.
I set variable weather but also so that there are floods and then drought again.
But there is a chance for the weather and the mood of the server. Who knows if there will be drought or eternal floods.

An enemy with a bat or claws already causes damage and kicks to your ass on the server.
 
I fixed the bug by walking in place and in the air. It's alright.
I increased the health of buildings and objects.
I fixed the light in the fireplace.
Fixed the Stamina consumption. (Stamina-Breath-Energy)

Mistakes:
[b]Enter[/b]
When you press ENTER, you crouch permanently.
Can be canceled with L-CTRL

[b]Abyss in the rock[/b]
There are a few places on the map where if you climb a rock you can sink in up to your waist.
Please take a picture of the position where it was and send it to Discord. But this applies to all errors that occur.
You can send it to me on Discord.

A couple of objects are untextured. I'm working on a fix.

Here is Discord to solve the problem.
[url=https://discord.gg/6uAjwNeSTW]Discord[/url]

Here is the 0.0.3 Dedicated server.
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ok_Njlj8Ddugf1SsN-SoD_74JpkkW2Nz?usp=sharing]PostApo - Dedicated Server 0.0.3[/url]


Thank you and have a great time.
We are at the beginning and it is a playtest please.

FussyCraft

notes.title: Alpha - Fisrt Realese Dedicated Server 0.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After some hard development I managed to learn the Unreal Engine network interface and the Steam network interface.
So I've reached the point where the game is running in C++ and using the source Unreal Engine.

This brought with it a dedicated server.

I want to thank everyone for not giving up on me and my game and coming all the way to this point.
Thank you.

I am releasing the server and the game for everyone for a certain period of time until further notice.
So everyone can test and play. But I will ask everyone to leave feedback in the discussions.
Your response will be very important to me now.
Write your knowledge, ideas, but also criticism.

I created a special map for this server. It is an inhospitable island. Everything is dry burnt.
There are few raw materials and little preserved nature. It is a Survival action. The water rises and falls according to the weather.
So, where there was dry land, there may be a flood later. Where there was no water. There is suddenly 3M of water.

Keep that in mind when you're building your base.


So there is a Client and a Server available.
I allow you to host the server. But it is necessary to open the ports: Default: 7777
Or to the port you choose. All server settings are in :Server.bat
Set the server name and port to change or leave.
Your IP address must be public.
I do not rule out functionality with RADMIN or Hamachi. I didn't test.

I currently host only one server for a maximum of 200 people.
I don't know the stability and we have to test all this.
I will greatly appreciate it if one of you will also set up servers.

I already work on safe zones and PVE servers.
So far it's only PVP. But you can make your own server or I have enabled SinglePlayer. (One player)
But I would be grateful if they used dedicated servers.

Here is the server for Windows 64bit.

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eL-nvayB9ZZxXiatj6uB1ddPAyDS57NQ?usp=sharing]Download Server - Dedicated Server[/url]


I am currently aware of a few errors that could occur in the game, so I will list them.

Please always read the update description so you know what has been done and what is not working.
Thank you.

[b]Inventory[/b]
It used to be that when you disconnected from the server and then came back. You had no inventory. You had to kill yourself with K. But now it's been over 30 sessions and it hasn't happened once. Nevertheless, I mention it.

[b]High Jump[/b]
Sometimes when you're a few meters above the ground and you decide to jump and fly, the running animation might start and you'll run in place. Either disconnect and connect or kill with "K".
This is done by the swimming component. I am working on it.

[b]Enter[/b]
When you press ENTER, you crouch permanently.
Can be canceled with L-CTRL

[b]Abyss in the rock[/b]
There are a couple of places on the map where if you rock climb you can sink in up to your waist.
Please take a picture of the position where it was and send it to Discord. But this applies to all errors that occur.
You can send it to me on Discord.

A couple of objects are untextured. I'm working on a fix.

Here is Discord to solve the problem.
[url=https://discord.gg/6uAjwNeSTW]Discord[/url]


Thank you and have a great time.
We are at the beginning and it is a playtest please.

FussyCraft

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello to everybody,

During the 3 day cycle, when I put sleep on the back burner, I managed to completely redo the game.
The game should finally take the right direction and has a lot to offer.
I'm leaving the game open for a crowd of people to flock here and give me feedback
he could improve the game. This makes PlayTest possible for everyone and for free. However, it will be nice if
you buy the game and support the development of the game. But it's up to each of you. There is an event here.

I built the game again from scratch.
  It's done in 3 days

Looting
Building
Cooking and Survival elements
Hunting
A sparsely populated map - but it is optimized
Game optimization
Character Selection
Multiplayer in progress
Ride the "Train"
Shop
AirDrop
And other

There is still work to be done
Please tolerate bugs in the game but report them - This is a PlayTest - not the final game.
You can write to me either on Steam or my Nick + @.gmail.com

Once the Multiplayer is finished, I believe that the game will immediately gain popularity and playability.
Thank you for investing your time in this game and me.
FussyCraft
